Oliver Robert Liam, a licensed and seasoned attorney based in Ontario,
Canada.

My late client, a dual citizen and owner of an oil servicing company in

of Air France Flight 4590 on June 1st, 2009. They were returning from a
summer holiday in Brazil, en route through Paris back to America, when the
unfortunate incident occurred. Sadly, the entire family perished in that
disaster.

Following their deaths, my client’s bank contacted me regarding his
substantial fixed deposit. Despite exhaustive efforts to locate any living
relatives, no family member could be found. Recently, the bank informed me
once again that unless a next of kin is presented without delay, they will
have no choice but to declare the account dormant and forward the funds to
the U.S. Federal Reserve, where it will be absorbed as government property.

Having considered this, I resolved to extend my search to any individual
bearing my late client’s surname. As his personal attorney, I possess all
relevant legal documents and have the authority to perfect new legal
instruments in the rightful heir’s name. With my professional expertise, I
can ensure this process is completed seamlessly, lawfully, and without any
risk to you.

to formally apply for its release in your favor once your details are
provided. For urgent matters, you may also reach me via WhatsApp at +1 610
747 8561.

To proceed with the legal documentation, may I kindly request the following
from you:

Your full name

Your age

Your profession

Your marital status

A copy of your valid identification

Upon receiving this information, I shall immediately obtain and legalize
the necessary court documents naming you as the bona fide next of kin. I
will then present them to the bank and proceed with the claim on your
behalf.

Please, do away with any fear or hesitation. This matter will be executed
strictly in accordance with the law and under my full professional
guidance. Your commitment and cooperation are all that is required to
ensure the successful transfer of these funds into your account.

I await your prompt response.

Yours faithfully,
Mr. Oliver Liam
